body: A tie-on Windsor chair seat cushion from Chtte. See the Etsy listing for size and color options.
evidence: Discovered on this run's Chtte storefront (13 cards), excluded all known listing IDs; only 4586894685 was new. Listing seller links matched Chtte. Selected C01 and S 15.7 × 13.8 in, quantity 1, and verified the main Add to cart button enabled. Selected first gallery image and visually inspected the rendered full-page screenshot: blue, brown, gray and beige rounded seat pads stacked on a wooden chair with ties visible. Image URL read from the same rendered main image. Chair Pads breadcrumb and Windsor seat pad title support existing P3 Kitchen & Dining route.
